market.summary: A strong Koha reuse opportunity across universities, national and municipal libraries, with an existing National Virtual Union Catalogue for public libraries. This bounded probe found 10 institutional book-search successes,4 selected and 6 reserves. Large research libraries remain priorities despite reachability and robots blockers. This is not national LMS market share or a largest-ten ranking.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritize Koha template compatibility, multilingual metadata and copy-status preservation. Begin with National Library and Rajarata plus sizeable municipal DLP sites; many major university origins need legitimate policy/reachability resolution. A new VuFind deployment adapter for the VUC could cover multiple public collections through institution filters, but the sampled holdings backend is under maintenance. Do not substitute indexed attribution for live circulation.

network_opportunities.name: National Virtual Union Catalogue / Digital Libraries Project
network_opportunities.scope: National Library says 25 public libraries plus National Library. The rendered list has 25 labels includingNational Library, so its claimed 26 total is not independently reconciled.
network_opportunities.verification: One broad title query and five separate institution-filtered queries returned books. National and three municipal direct Koha catalogs separately succeeded. The union is not counted as an additional institution; sampled Ampara record reports maintenance and unavailable holdings service.
network_opportunities.integration_implication: High shared-search opportunity through VuFind building filters and institution-prefixed IDs; direct DLP Koha connectors can expose more precise current status. Preserve index freshness uncertainty.

limitations: Ten selected substantial targets were not achieved:4 selected,6 reserves. Ten institutions returned actual books; that does not remove the six-target shortfall.
No national largest-ten ranking established; dates, units and institutional proxies differ. Original ten major priorities remain visible; nine could not be queried.
Collection figures are undated or historical and often self-published; National Library homepage and catalog counts conflict. Do not aggregate these into national inventory.

HTTP 503 and timeout observations can originate in network/proxy paths and are not proof that libraries are globally offline. They also are not policy clearance. No restricted, private, authenticated or challenge-bypass route was used.
Three DLP robots endpoints return 200 ordinary Koha Error 404 HTML; manually documented one-query exceptions are not continuing access/reuse authorization.

Five VUC successes prove indexed library attribution through actual filters. Search status stays Loading; sampled detail says System Under Maintenance. No live circulation claim is established for union reserves.
Batticaloa direct query has 15 records while union facet has 16; do not assume synchronized union holdings.
Ambalangoda and Doluwa returned related-title/different-author records, explicitly not matched to a Hemingway edition.
Only English query text was submitted. Sinhala translated titles appeared. Sinhala/Tamil input, normalization, transliteration and ISBN matching remain untested.
Reader entry, borrowing, license and current availability are separate. Public catalog access is not permission to borrow or to bulk reuse records.
No application configuration, adapter implementation, live app test, outreach, authentication or production changes.
